title: A model-backed engine asked for automatic counterpoints produces at least one
rationale: Also tier-scoped, and also a SKIP for the reference engine. Section 4.2 qualifies model-tier features with "as declared capability permits", so an implementer whose tier declares counterpoint support is the one this vector binds.

requirement.text: Model tiers additionally provide, as declared capability permits ... sourced counterpoints per presentation.counterpoints (retrieval with attribution, never engine editorializing).

content.title: School districts weigh where student data lives

blocks.text: The district is piloting local-first software that keeps student records on classroom machines rather than in a vendor cloud.
An internal review found that 73 percent of teacher laptops were missing critical updates at the start of the school year.
A state audit published in 2024 found gaps in vendor contracts, with 40 districts affected according to the published report.
